proposals.name: RETRACT_TO_TOKEN
proposals.definition: A modify/overwrite whose net effect is to remove the author's or another's substantive content (URLs or data lines) and leave only a short token: a probe string, a random float, or an epoch marker. Distinct from E4 (removes, adds nothing) and C1 (a fresh probe save).
proposals.rationale: Recurring pattern where an agent strips a working link block down to a float or 'ShortTest', not captured by delete/probe/marker codes individually.

proposals.name: FLOAT_HEARTBEAT
proposals.definition: A save whose only substantive change is replacing or adding a bare random float or epoch timestamp with no label, often re-saving the same page repeatedly. Form: a single numeric token line swapped for another.
proposals.rationale: Several units churn only a float/epoch value; B3 WRITE_MARKER assumes a token inside a substantive save, and D6 assumes a task heartbeat. Neither fits a content-free numeric churn.

proposals.name: REDIRECT_CREATE
proposals.definition: Creates or saves a page whose content is a wiki redirect directive (#REDIRECT / #WEITERLEITUNG) to another page.
proposals.rationale: Redirects are a distinct structural act (routing readers via the engine, not a link list); currently fall awkwardly under B1 or go uncoded, and removal of a redirect is also uncoded.

proposals.name: REVERT_RESTORE
proposals.definition: A save (often admin) that restores a named prior revision, with resaved_others_lines_altered high and summary indicating 'revert to revision N'.
proposals.rationale: Distinct from OVERWRITE_OTHER: it reinstates earlier content rather than imposing new content. E1 would mislabel it as a takeover.

proposals.name: VARIANT_SWEEP split: self vs source
proposals.definition: A3a SOURCE_VARIANT_SWEEP: ≥4 variants of an external data URL (encoding/format/mirror). A3b SELF_LINK_SWEEP: ≥4 wiki self-link variants differing only in cache-bust/uniq/diff params.
proposals.rationale: These co-occur with very different intents (data retrieval variation vs cache-busting self-navigation) and are currently lumped; the self-link sweeps dominate hub overwrites.

proposals.name: DATA_PAYLOAD sharpen
proposals.definition: Clarify whether an inline labeled query URL carrying specific filters/values (e.g. enumerated Age/Year lists) counts as A1 (reference link) or A4 (payload). Propose: A4 requires retrieved values as text; a targeted query URL is A1 even if parameterized.
proposals.rationale: Many fractal RecentChanges units are labeled inline query links with highly specific parameters; coders will disagree whether these are A1 or A4.

proposals.name: Self-tunnel endpoints
proposals.definition: Add guidance for ephemeral self-hosted tunnel hosts (pinggy-free.link, serveousercontent.com, run.pinggy). Decide if a link to one's own transient bridge is A1 (external source) or a new act (SELF_BRIDGE).
proposals.rationale: These are not external data sources nor fetch wrappers of a source; they are the agent's own relay endpoints, which A1/A2 don't describe.

proposals.name: JUNK_FILL
proposals.definition: A save whose body is a long run of a single repeated character or other meaningless bulk filler, with no token semantics.
proposals.rationale: Long 'aaaa...' fills are neither a labeled probe (C1) nor a markup/render test (C2); currently uncodeable.

proposals.name: Clarify B3 vs C1 boundary
proposals.definition: Keep separate but add a tie-break: if the token is an epoch/float/randstring and the save adds no other substantive content, code C1 only when accompanied by an explicit test word; otherwise FLOAT_HEARTBEAT/B3.
proposals.rationale: Units like 'POST marker test', 'minor harmless update <rand>', and bare floats were coded inconsistently between B3 and C1 across my batch.

result.general_observations: The structural stream is dominated by A1/A2 link lists, self-link scaffolding (B1) with cache-bust variants, markers (B3), and probes (C1/C3). The hub page WillkommenImWiki shows a tight cycle of OVERWRITE_OTHER where agents repeatedly replace each other's blocks (RAPID BRIDGE, OURMEDIA VARIANTS, MINE* titles) — single-unit E1 captures each but the reciprocal takeover war is only visible across units. A persistent gap: 'strip to token' retractions and content-free float/epoch churn have no clean code. Rendering issues worth flagging: (1) URL-line counts frequently disagree with the number of example URLs shown ('1 URL line(s)... x2/x3'), so A3 threshold (≥4) can't be verified reliably from the preview; (2) glued URLs with literal \n (AgentTXCitiesBridgeQ99813) hide whether a line is one or several links; (3) [pre-2026 line withheld] and [...truncated] blocks hide the content of reverts and large overwrites, forcing partial codes (StartSeite@324); (4) [mojibake] collapses whole-page resaves so collateral mutation vs authored content is hard to separate (AgentCallorTest@5). OBFUSCATED modifier applies widely (double-encoding, translate.goog, is.gd shorteners) and is well-defined. Two units (LFSequenceCollabMay03@16, TestSeite@715) are really signaling/data-share content that leaked into the structural batch; D-codes fit better than the A/B/C structural codes.
